author: Logos V
title: Logos V: Bridging the Gap - PCA(100)->Harmony->DAQB(kd=10)
abstract: Continuing the sweep to resolve the Harmony-DAQB synergy. This experiment tests a lower k_density of 10 in the DAQB algorithm, applied to the PCA(100)->Harmony corrected space. This will help determine if the optimal density assumption for DAQB changes after Harmony correction.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy.sparse import issparse

sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from bbsg_density_adaptive import build_density_adaptive_bbsg # Using my corrected version

def _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, target_sum=1e4):
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=target_sum, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata):
    # --- Optimized Harmony Component ---
    n_pcs = 100
    # --- DAQB Component ---
    k_total = 50
    metric = 'cosine'
    delta = 0.1 
    # --- PARAMETER BEING TESTED ---
    k_density = 10
    # ------------------------------

    _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, 1e4)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    
    # 1. Standard PCA 
    sc.pp.pca(adata, use_highly_variable=True, n_comps=n_pcs, random_state=0)
    
    # 2. Harmony for batch correction
    sc.external.pp.harmony_integrate(adata, key='batch', basis='X_pca', adjusted_basis='X_harmony', max_iter_harmony=20)
    Z_harmony = adata.obsm['X_harmony']
    
    # 3. DAQB on the Harmony-corrected space
    Cg, Dg = build_density_adaptive_bbsg(Z_harmony.astype(np.float32), batches=adata.obs['batch'].values, 
                                         k_total=k_total, metric=metric, delta=delta, k_density=k_density, rng_seed=0)
    
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = Cg
    adata.obsp['distances'] = Dg
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = Z_harmony
    
    return adata
